title: Understanding and Mitigating Numerical Sources of Nondeterminism in LLM In

predicted_errors.error_location: Section 3.2, text describing divergence under FP32
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The text claims: 'With FP32, almost all examples produce identical outputs across configurations, resulting in only 2.2% of the samples diverging.' However, Table 9 (Div_Percent) shows for DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B on MATH500 under FP32, Div_Percent = 5.80%, not 2.2%. The stated percentage directly contradicts the table.

The LayerCast description states: '(3) performing computations without upcasting to FP32 at runtime.' This directly contradicts the abstract ('performs all computations in FP32') and the following paragraph ('this approach ensures all computations occur in full FP32 precision'). The method cannot both avoid upcasting and perform computations in FP32; the description is logically inconsistent.

The text contains a dangling, incomplete paragraph: 'Error bars. Note that with 16-bit precision and small datasets, more trials are needed for stable results in general. (2) If using greedy decoding with a single run, please use FP32 precision to improve the reproducibility of your results.' This fragment is not integrated into the narrative, is not introduced, and appears to be an editing remnant.
